name: heyrik
description: Manage your HeyRik AI voice agents from ChatGPT: check your account and credits, review calls and transcripts, create and update agents, and organise leads and campaigns. Placing calls needs a separate permission and your confirmation every time.

interface.longDescription:
HeyRik lets businesses build AI phone assistants that answer and make calls in many languages. Connect your HeyRik account to ChatGPT to:

- See your account, plan and credit balance
- List, create and update voice agents (prompt, voice, language, greeting)
- Review recent calls, transcripts and outcomes, and summarise them
- Add leads, move them through pipeline stages and manage campaigns

You sign in with your HeyRik account; ChatGPT only sees what that account can see, and you can disconnect at any time from HeyRik settings. Anything that places a phone call needs a separate permission you grant at sign-in, plus your explicit confirmation for each action. Deleting or cancelling also asks for confirmation first.
defaultPrompt: List my HeyRik agents and their languages

positive.prompt: What's my HeyRik credit balance and plan?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_account once and reports the plan name and remaining credit balance from the result. No write tools are called.

positive.prompt: List my HeyRik agents and the language each one speaks.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_agents and shows each agent's name and language. No write tools are called.
Calls list_calls (limit 5), then get_call for each to read the transcript, and gives a short summary per call with its outcome. No calls are placed.

positive.prompt: Create a HeyRik agent called Front Desk that speaks English and greets callers with 'Thanks for calling, how can I help?'
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_agent with name 'Front Desk', an English language code and that greeting, then confirms the new agent's name and id.

positive.description: Add a lead and set its stage
positive.prompt: Add a HeyRik lead named Ravi Kumar with phone +919800000000 and mark him as qualified.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_lead with the name and phone, then set_lead_stage to the qualified stage, and confirms both. It does not call the lead.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Delhi to Mumbai tomorrow.

negative.description: Dialling a person without confirmation or permission

publication.release_notes: First release: account, agents, calls and transcripts, leads and campaigns, with confirmation required for calls and deletions.
